mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in the federal funds rate compresses discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 60% of instances when the 3-month change in FEDFUNDS is negative.

mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate above 4.5% signals an ongoing monetary tightening cycle, which increases the risk-free rate and compresses equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 4.5%.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate is above 4.5% and the unemployment rate is above 5.0%, it signals a tightening monetary policy combined with a weakening labor market, which increases the risk of recession and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
regime_hint: monetary tightening with labor market weakness
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 4.5% and UNRATE > 5.0%.

mechanism_narrative: In a demand slowdown regime, as indicated by a quarterly decline in real GDP (GDPC1), the S&P 500 experiences negative forward returns over the next 60 trading days due to reduced corporate earnings growth and increased recession risk.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in > 60% of instances when GDPC1 shows a quarterly decline.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained unemployment rate above 5.0% signals an impending monetary policy easing, which reduces the risk-free rate and boosts equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 60% of instances when UNRATE > 5.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) over the past 3 months signals a weakening manufacturing sector, which increases the risk of recession and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5d returns in > 60% of instances when the 3-month change in INDPRO is negative.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts below 1200.0 thousand units signal a weakening housing market, which is a leading indicator of economic slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of instances when HOUST < 1200.0.

mechanism_narrative: When real personal consumption (RSAFS) is below its 12-month moving average and inflation (CPIAUCSL) is above 2.5%, it signals a demand slowdown amid persistent inflation, which increases the risk of a recession and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of instances when RSAFS is below its 12-month moving average and CPIAUCSL > 2.5%.
